failures.message: names nothing the suite ran at head — When the packaged commit is not an ancestor of the fetched head, the range starts at its rebased copy. That copy is the commit on the head's first-parent chain whose full message equals the packaged commit's. The witness restacks the task's branch onto its moved predecessor, then adds two review commits. The newer one repeats the packaged commit's subject with another body, and each adds its own line. Each system prompt holds both review commits' added lines. It holds neither the predecessor's moved line nor the packaged commit's added line.
